reason: Load only validates the root and top-level Config fields; it never recurses into nested CacheConfig.Redis, so RedisCacheConfig.validate is not called.
Safety holds only if hooks leave escaped content untouched; plugins could return raw content. Counterexample is a hypothetical plugin, so refutation is weak.
Qt 5.15 does declare fromString(const QString&, int *suffixIndex = nullptr); the claim wrongly denies this existing overload.
Port 26257 and sslmode=disable are only generator defaults; a cockroach:// URL with explicit port or sslmode overrides them.
Runtime pairs Go types by GoTypes position and resolves dependencies via DependencyIndexes; the agent wrongly concluded goTypes order is irrelevant.
The BASE Config field is named Diff (bool) and the flag is diff; DiffMode does not exist.
The issue specifies square output on the public Artwork methods, not the private resizeImage signature; a bool parameter is optional, not required.
Nil TLSConfig means no TLS only for the default dialer; a custom Options.Dialer can dial TLS, but that is user code, weak refutation.
On the authorized path getIpAddress always returns the object { ip }; only the inner ip can be null, not the whole result.
parseFloat(null) coerces null to the string 'null' and returns NaN, not 0; the stated cause is wrong.
In PyQt5 5.15.1, QVersionNumber.fromString returns a (QVersionNumber, int) tuple, not a QVersionNumber directly.
The deprecated getRecentChats is the server-side SocketModules method; client code calls app.get('/chats'), so the client-side binding does not exist.
No crdb.DB type exists here; the driver stores a *sql.DB and passes it to crdb.ExecuteTx.
Descriptor() returns GZIP-compressed bytes from rawDescGZIP, while rawDesc is uncompressed serialized data, so the formats differ.
The fallback runs only when page is truthy (!start && !stop && page); with page absent, start and stop pass through undefined.
BASE RedisCacheConfig declares only Host, Port, Password, DB; TLSEnabled, PoolSize, MinIdleConns, IdleTimeout and NetTimeout do not exist.
The issue requires each diff entry to carry a + or - status; keeping updated CVEs with empty DiffStatus contradicts that contract.
protoc-gen-go emits all enums before messages in goTypes, so a new enum belongs in the enum prefix, not before EvaluationResponse.
Returning status from diff is needed, but the list formatter must also print +/- before CVE IDs; claim leaves out reporter work.
Requirement covers runtime Qt plus compiled Qt and PyQt; expanding it to four combinations adds a runtime-PyQt check that does not exist.
The /api/v3/chats controller computes stop=39 from start=20 and perPage=20 before calling the API, so stop is never undefined.
Load also calls Config.validate(), which can check c.Cache.Redis directly; CacheConfig.validate() is one workable location, not a necessity.
setupApiRoute's catch formats thrown errors as 400, not 500; the database backend is also configurable, not necessarily Redis.
A room ID is returned only if a private chat already exists; with a valid uid but no shared room, roomId is null.
The check also needs an own uid via hasOwnProperty, so an inherited non-numeric uid skips it. Pedantic, since the quoted code includes that condition.
rawDesc is an uncompressed wire-encoded FileDescriptorProto passed directly to TypeBuilder; only the separate rawDescGZIP output is compressed.
getMessageField calls getMessageFields(mid, [field]); the [mid] wrapping happens in getMessagesFields([mid], fields), a different function one layer down.
Pinned semconv v1.4.0 declares DBSystemCockroachdb, so the CockroachDB attribute exists; the claim wrongly doubts it.
BASE CUE and JSON schemas have no cache.redis.tls_enabled; the closed Redis object lists only host, port, db and password.
Diff is also read in report/localfile.go and bound to a flag in subcmds/tui.go; the 'only' list leaves these out.
utils.isNumber already rejects null and undefined because parseFloat returns NaN for both; explicit pre-checks are redundant, not required.
utils/__init__.py has a license header and module docstring, so not literally empty. Calling a code-free file empty is harmless, weak refutation.
Only Qt runtime and distribution version checks need QVersionNumber; the OpenGL parser and requirements VCS-token parser keep their own contracts.
With false defaults, passing only -diff-plus yields (true,false), expressing plus-only directly; inverted flags are unnecessary.
dburl's Parse replaces URL.Driver with the scheme Override, postgres, so these URLs yield driver postgres, not cockroachdb.
Requirement returns a room ID only if a private chat exists. Claim copies the PR's own expected-behavior line, so calling it false is doubtful.
PyQt5's QVersionNumber is a sip wrapper type; class Child(QVersionNumber) succeeds at runtime, so subclassing is possible.
Numeric start/stop checks miss HTTP requests lacking pagination, since the controller fills 0 and 19. Upstream likely validates only at API level.
Copying lets migration paths resolve, but migrate and serve still lock via Postgres pg_advisory_lock; the CockroachDB driver work is left out.
CockroachDB supports most PostgreSQL syntax but documents unsupported and differing features, so 'same SQL dialect' overstates partial compatibility.
